module: rs.core.serialize.psm1 — Invoke-Serialize(-Plan -Entries -Layout -OutDir [-Buffering]) → receipt. Emission loop over the plan; one path regardless of grouping; a per-shard writer (open → header row → rows → close) carrying the cursor and returning offsets as the receipt of the write. FILED, NOT STARTED (shard-container-brief).
$comment: Export phase 2 — the ONLY stage that writes shard files. Consumes the plan (membership + order), the layout (header row text, columns, framing), and the entries (content), and renders via container's Build-HeaderRow / Build-Row so plan and file cannot disagree. Offsets are MEASURED here as a receipt — never derived from Measure-Row, never recovered from written bytes (LTS regex recovery is what must not come across). Serialize never reports back into the plan (no feedback loop). Writes UTF-8 without BOM, LF only, explicitly, regardless of platform. Buffers per shard, not per corpus. Emission column knobs are LAYOUT knobs (resolved before shards) — serialize has only I/O knobs; Compress is not inline (would break plan = file).

OutDir.note: target directory; shard filename = <ShardStem>_<Key>.txt (.txt as reader accommodation, container.spec.jsonc identity)

Buffering.note: PerShard (default): render one shard in memory, write, keep only its receipt. Stream: write rows as rendered. Same bytes either way

Shards.note: iterated in Ordinal order; each shard's Entries[] gives membership and order

Plan.note: read for ShardCount / IdxWidth echo into the receipt; not mutated

Entries.note: references into assemble.out.result.Entries, in shard order

PlannedSizeBytes.note: asserted equal to the written ByteLength — the plan = file gate lives here

IsOversized.note: carried into the receipt so manifest can declare it without re-joining the plan (or manifest joins — either; carried is cheaper)

HeaderRowText.note: written first in every shard, byte-identical

HeaderBytes.note: cursor after the header row; first row's RowOffset

Columns.note: what Build-Row renders per entry — sources, types, widths, block sub-fields

Framing.note: separator character, item join, record delimiter, empty marker, encoding

Content.note: encoded by the container codec at render time (ConvertTo-ContentSpan); content_bytes = its UTF-8 byte count

IdxMap.note: RelativePath → placement; looked up per row when gidx is enabled

GlobalIdx.note: → gidx column value, zero-padded to layout.IdxWidth

Encoding.note: 'utf-8' — no BOM; the emission-encoding declaration (ledger #17) surfaces here for the manifest

IsOversized.note: carried so manifest need not re-join the plan

RelativePath.note: join key to the entry / idxmap

RowOffset.note: byte offset of the row's first byte in the shard file (0-based); the header row occupies [0, HeaderBytes)

RowMetaEnd.note: last byte of the row's prefix (everything before the content delimiter) — INCLUSIVE, LTS semantics kept (payload-manifest-ledger #8: offsets need their unit)

RowContentBegin.note: first byte of the content span

RowContentEnd.note: last byte of the content span, INCLUSIVE; == RowContentBegin + ContentBytes − 1

ContentBytes.note: the content_bytes column value; RowContentEnd − RowContentBegin + 1
